purpose: New authorized exploratory development experiment after closed calibration/diagnosis; no reopening of old gates

size_jitter.assignment: SHA256 augmentation_seed:sample_id, numpy default_rng, clean if integers(3)==0 else integers(-32,33); one fixed flow view for every prefix and every forest seed

stress_note: Same near-large-packet transform at fixed +/-20 bytes, raw units. Abstract metadata stress, not a protocol simulation, actual IPv6 traffic or a repaired accuracy claim.
additional_gates: No clean local mean-budget class-recall regression; no stressed local mean-budget class-recall regression, each>=0.65; each local class stress recall averaged over both signs at10 packets>=0.65; public stress mean macro-F1 must not regress and each public stress class recall may lose at most0.05. All relative to the same-seed matched clean control, not different prior cohorts.
selection: Seed17 only. Require exact original forest-weight checksum reproduction by clean seed17 control before scoring treatments. Eligible arm with highest local stressed mean-budget/sign macro-F1; prefer relative-size within0.01 of best. No eligible arm stops all repetitions. Otherwise freeze that arm and run only clean plus that arm at42/123. Both repetitions must meet unchanged gates; never replace seed17 with a better seed or rescue by switching arms.
reporting: Clean and +/-20 stress: per-budget confusion matrices, per-class precision/recall/F1/support, saved probability vectors, requested and actual prefix lengths. Local only available budgets; historical public control uses first50 per class in stored order and available prefix up to each requested budget, exactly as original control. Correlated cases; reused development cohorts, no significance or prospective generalization claim.
limits: No failed calibration, previous paired comparison, diagnostic captures, public calibration or public final reads. No role conversion. Original43 local training and17 local selection connections only, hashes bound to reference artifact provenance, no fresh packet QC claim. Training-only abstract augmentation; relative features use only current prefix maximum and no fit. No endpoint/process/domain features. No SupCon, extra architecture, hyperparameter sweep, policy fitting, automatic capture or deployment. After results stop; real IPv4/IPv6 local quality and separate calibration/final/live validation require a new declared future collection. B17 stays default.

benchmark.boundary: single trained-model predict reply, excludes capture/HTTP/UI/loading
